thresholds.objective: maximum F1 per class on the validation split
thresholds.ceiling_rule: the grid runs 0.05 to 0.95 and extends to 0.99 only when the maximum F1 lands on 0.95; ties go to the higher cut

split.source: split column of the cond15 label table

config.recipe: resnet50, 224, batch 8, 50 epochs, no early stopping, SGD lr 1e-4 momentum 0.9 (nesterov, weight decay 1e-4), seed 42, BCEWithLogitsLoss
config.truth: class-level for the object columns whatever the arm trained on
